title: The midnight laundrette
alt: A woman reading on a blue bench and a man drawing a sheet from a dryer in a rain-lit laundrette.
description: Two-person photographic generation, with distinct actions, reflective surfaces and mixed lighting.
prompt: An atmospheric cinematic still inside a neighbourhood laundrette after midnight. An adult woman in a red raincoat sits on a blue bench reading a small unmarked book; an adult man in a dark coat stands beside one open dryer, lifting a pale bedsheet from its circular door. Stainless circular machines, tiled floor, warm vending-machine glow, rain on the front window and reflections on the pavement outside. Both people fully coherent with natural faces and hands; the sheet connects to the open dryer, layered photographic lighting, no visible lettering.
